bio.text: Clay Fuller is a member of the U.S. House from Georgia; before Congress he was District Attorney for the four-county Lookout Mountain Judicial Circuit in northwest Georgia.
He is a lieutenant colonel and deputy staff judge advocate in the Air National Guard, was a White House Fellow in 2018-2019, and deployed to Qatar from May to November 2024.
He graduated from Emory University, and holds an M.P.A. from Cornell University and a J.D. from Southern Methodist University.
